names: Mountainous Republic of the Northern Caucasus
title: Mountainous Republic of the Northern Caucasus
capsule: The Mountainous Republic of the Northern Caucasus was a confederal parliamentary republic declared on 11 May 1918 at Vladikavkaz, uniting Chechens, Ingush, Dagestanis, Ossetians, and Circassians in the chaotic aftermath of Russia's imperial collapse. Its first prime minister was the Chechen oil entrepreneur Tapa Tchermoeff and its foreign minister the Kumyk intellectual Haidar Bammate, who secured recognition from the Central Powers, Britain, Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan. Denikin's White Army overran the republic's Chechen and Dagestani territories by May 1919; the North Caucasian Emirate briefly succeeded it before Soviet forces consolidated control of the entire region in 1921.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The general territory claimed by the republic is documented, but effective control shifted rapidly during the Russian Civil War and the republic never administered more than parts of its claimed area; boundaries are approximate.
